name: Field
role: Dakota sub-commissioner to the New Orleans world's fair
bio: Mr. Field, sub-commissioner of Dakota to the New Orleans world's fair, was in Medora in October 1884 collecting specimens and curiosities for the exposition. In August 1884 the Cow Boy reprinted a Livingston Enterprise report that twenty horses had disappeared from a Mr. Field's herd.

moments.label: Collected Bad Lands specimens for New Orleans

mentions: Twenty horses disappeared on Friday night from Mr. Field's herd, which was grazing near town. They are supposed to have been stolen. They are branded M P combined, or half circle R A.—[Livingstone Enterprise.
From the rustling ability of Messrs. Field, Roberts, Smith and Paddock we can rest assured that the Bad Lands will be well represented at the New Orleans exposition.
